integrity: The proof uses classical Legendre identities and asymptotics, a discrete midpoint concentration argument, and an exact reflected-eigenvalue comparison. The finite standalone arithmetic checks supplement, rather than replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the explicit normalized shifted-Legendre residual family on SPD quadratics, with one fixed spectral outlier, equally spaced midpoint bulk eigenvalues, and Gaussian isotropic initialization. The condition d_n/n^4 -> infinity is sufficient, not asserted optimal. The chi-square result is asymptotic and has not received independent validation; historical precedence remains qualified by an abstract-only 1995 source.
title: A sharp spectral-spike crossover for Legendre-residual acceleration
